div.div: مِعْصَالٌ A stick, or staff, with a crooked, or bent, head, with which one reaches, or takes hold of, [or draws towards him,] the branches of a tree. (IDrd, O, K.) And The [kind of goff-stick called] صَوْلَجَان [q. v.]; as also ↓ مِعْصِيلٌ . (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
